Subject: Rotating premium demo slot — proposed multi‑TZ baton

Hi Samir,

Great to meet earlier — thanks again for the honest run through of BrightHealth's priority use cases (faster triage for claims routing + embedding-driven search for provider docs). As discussed, the best next step is a 60‑minute technical deep dive with our solutions engineer to validate integration surface area and latency targets.

Because you mentioned stakeholders across US/EU/APAC, I sketched a rotating weekly "premium slot" cadence so the same SE pair can cover an equitable distribution of prime hours without burning anyone out. Attached is an availability grid with the suggested rotation pattern. High level:

- Week A (example): US morning slot (PDT) — target audience: Product + Infrastructure
- Week B: EU late morning (BST/CEST) — target audience: Security + Data
- Week C: APAC early evening (SGT/AWST) — target audience: Integrations + Ops

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm which of the candidate slots work for your group (see attachment).
2) We'll lock a 60‑minute slot and include Dev + one rotating SE.
3) If you prefer, we can keep this as a recurring 3‑week baton rotation or run it as a one‑off series for your initial pilot.

Candidate slots (all 60m):
- Tue 2025‑06‑30 09:00–10:00 PDT / 16:00–17:00 BST / Wed 01:00–02:00 SGT
- Thu 2025‑07‑02 08:00–09:00 PDT / 15:00–16:00 BST / Fri 03:00–04:00 SGT
- Fri 2025‑07‑03 11:00–12:00 PDT / 18:00–19:00 BST / Sat 04:00–05:00 SGT

If none of those fit, tell me two preferred windows and we'll propose swaps.

Attachments: availability_grid.xlsx (rotating matrix), demo-agenda.md (what we'll cover).

Thanks — I'll hold the slots for now until I hear back.

—
Soojin Lee

Thanks Soojin — useful framing and appreciate the thought on fairness across regions. Quick notes from our side:

- We like the rotating baton idea. We're trying to keep core stakeholders (sec + platform) out of early mornings, so EU mornings are usually preferable to afternoons.
- Avoid Wednesdays for EU leadership (standing review).
- For APAC, Thurs evenings are generally better than Fridays — our Singapore team has a Friday wrap‑up.

From the candidate slots you listed, Thu 2025‑07‑02 15:00–16:00 BST would work best for the majority locally (we may loop in a colleague from Integrations).

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you confirm who will attend from Redwood (SE name + engineering lead)?
2) I need a brief agenda in calendar invite format so I can forward to our security reviewer.

If that's confirmed, I'll approve the slot and send a calendar accept.
